item.title: Grammatical error
item.content:encoded:
Analysis of the video log shows that the subject's legs appeared to be being bitten by a large number of small creatures; based on concurrent wounds, at least 27 bites were being inflicted at any at one time.

That should be either "at any time", "at one time", or "at any one time". I am changing it to the last. If that is wrong, do correct me.

item.content:encoded:
From what I understand, they don't see the same thing every time. The one who did is a single example, so I don't know if that's enough to confirm the theory. It also may just show you the same room/location, not the same other person/thing/entity. I wouldn't mind seeing more tests with repeat subjects.

Regardless, it is nice they aren't all being slaughtered for no reason. The one who recovered 507 being killed doesn't make a ton of sense to me, though. Unless 507 started spouting off about his "ability" right away, they could have just told the D-class that the guy was going to be quarantined and interrogated to discover where he's from or something. I imagine 507 has been given some amount of training or debriefing to not tell D-class people about himself unless it's part of an experiment.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Thanks; it's my first effort, and I'm still working on getting the wording right.

I agree that the test logs need more, but I was trying to avoid falling into the 'It kills everyone' cliche, as well as putting too much into it at first. I have a number of ideas to explore with it, like the idea that the perception of the object is required, so that sedating a subject into unconsciousness (or having their eyes eaten/plucked/otherwise rendered inoperable) could terminate the effect.

As to the termination of D-Classes.. I think you may be right; I was trying to maintain the normal, rather callous feel about them (since they will be terminated at the end of the month, anyway), but perhaps the survivors should be help for additional testing.. I.e., test until destruction or their time is up.

Thanks for the feedback, tho.. I'm rather pleasantly surprised at the response, for a first effort :)
